products.categoriesDesc: Organise products by type, characteristics and purpose.
products.positionsDesc: Organise products by storage location such as fridges, shelves and compartments.
products.unitsDesc: Each product has a base unit (e.g. Dose) and conversion units (e.g. Box = 10 Doses), set up in each product.
products.lotsDesc: Enabled per product. Lot-tracked products are sold first-expired, first-out (FEFO) and expired lots cannot be sold.
products.costMethodDesc: Cost is recalculated after every goods receipt / purchase return using the weighted average (purchase prices include VAT).

orders.allowNegative: Allow transactions when out of stock
orders.allowNegativeDesc: Sales and purchase returns are allowed even without enough stock; negative stock is offset by the next goods receipt.
orders.allowNegativeNote: Note: does not apply to lot/expiry-tracked products (vaccines always require enough unexpired lots).
orders.returnLimitDesc: Only accept returns within a set number of days from the sale date.
orders.lockTime: Do not allow changing transaction time
orders.lockTimeDesc: When on, nobody can change the sale time of an existing invoice.
orders.blockEInvoice: Block editing/cancelling invoices with an issued e-invoice
orders.blockEInvoiceDesc: When on, invoices whose e-invoice has been issued cannot be edited or cancelled.
orders.codeRuleDesc: Codes for invoices, returns and receipts/payments are generated automatically in order of creation.
orders.codeRuleOthers: Return: TH000001 · Receipt: PT000001 · Payment: PC000001

channels.title: Sales channels
channels.description: Channel selected on the selling screen (Facebook, Zalo, Website...) — used to filter / group reports.

customers.debtAlertDesc: Show a warning on the selling screen when a customer's debt exceeds the limit.
customers.requiredFieldsDesc: Choose which customer fields are mandatory.

tax.vatDesc: Set the tax calculation method, default tax rate and rates by business sector.
tax.directMethod: Direct method — % of revenue by business sector
tax.promptTaxCode: Enter the tax code (10 or 13 digits):
tax.noProfiles: No tax codes yet. Click “Add tax code” to get started.

einvoice.title: E-invoices
einvoice.description: Issue cash-register e-invoices through MISA meInvoice (no USB token needed).
einvoice.providerDescBefore: MISA meInvoice. The AppID is issued by MISA when you register for integration. Try the
einvoice.providerDescAfter: environment first before switching to Production.
einvoice.connectionDesc: meInvoice account details and the invoice series used when issuing.
einvoice.sendEmail: Automatically email the invoice to the customer (if they have an email)

branches.hint: Each branch (vaccination site) has its own stock, cash book and users. Assign users to branches in User management.
branches.title: Branch management
branches.description: Manage branch details, users and addresses.

lock.title: Book closing
lock.description: To keep reports accurate, transactions dated on or before the closing date cannot be created, edited or cancelled, and transaction dates cannot be moved before it.

bankAccounts.title: Receipt & payment accounts
bankAccounts.description: Manage the bank accounts and e-wallets used for the store's receipts and payments.
bankAccounts.missingBin: missing BIN — cannot create QR code
bankAccounts.confirmDelete: Delete account {accountNo}? Existing receipts and payments are not affected.

payments.sepayDesc: As soon as money arrives, the selling screen is notified and matches it to the invoice — no lost payments, no manual reconciliation.
payments.step1: Step 1 — Sign up for SePay and link your bank accounts
payments.step1Desc: Create an account at sepay.vn and link the receiving bank accounts (the same as in Settings → Cash flow).
payments.step2: Step 2 — Create a webhook in SePay
payments.step2Desc: Choose API Key authentication and the event “Money in”. Paste the URL below into the webhook URL field.
payments.webhookNote: The URL must be reachable from the Internet (a server with a domain name). SePay cannot reach a machine on a local network.
payments.step3: Step 3 — Enter the API key set in SePay
payments.keySaved: API key saved. Enter a new key to change it.
payments.autoComplete: Complete invoices automatically when fully paid
payments.autoCompleteDesc: When the customer scans the QR code on the selling screen and transfers the full amount, the invoice completes without pressing Pay.
payments.txDesc: Reported by SePay; a value in the Payment code column means it was matched to a QR code on the selling screen.

store.title: Store information
store.logoNote: Note: Max 2MB. The image is printed at the top of invoices.
store.name: Store name
store.accessCodeLabel: Access address (entered at the first login step)
store.accessCodeNote: Only the store owner can change it in Store profile → Update → Rename store (all devices will be signed out).

users.hint: Set default permissions by role to assign user permissions quickly.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by username, full name, phone

reset2fa.title: Reset two-factor authentication
reset2fa.description: Account {username} will have two-factor authentication turned off, lose all recovery codes and be signed out of every device. The user needs to turn two-factor authentication on again after signing in.

roleForm.name: Role name *
roleForm.adminNote: The Administrator role always has all permissions.
roleForm.updated: Role updated — takes effect when users sign in again

auditLogs.hint: Review employee actions by feature to trace changes when needed.
auditLogs.title: Activity log
auditLogs.description: Track every action employees take in the system.

notifications.alertsDesc: The system sends alerts to the Inbox per branch and hides them automatically once they no longer apply.
notifications.expiryDesc: Warn before lots in stock reach their expiry date. Expired lots still in stock are always flagged.
notifications.otherAlertsDesc: Products below minimum stock, failed e-invoice issuance, orders due for delivery, returned shipments, bank transfers received via SePay (when enabled). Users only see alerts allowed by their permissions.
notifications.announcementsDesc: Send a notification to all users, shown in the Updates tab of the Inbox.
